mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the completed pathways to the brain and spinal cord was most worthwhile because it brought sensing and movement together into a useful relationship.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the stretch and touch pathways into named slots was clear but somewhat repetitive; the decisions largely followed the slot labels.

surprise.text: The sensory ending wrapping around fibres inside the muscle spindle made the stretch pathway more concrete than I expected.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary. The pictures and slot names gave each connection a recognizable purpose, though they also made several choices predictable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter: the final connection made me curious about how the arm's dependence on the rest of the body will be developed.
